name: Jitaku Keibiin 2
source:
My name is Haibara Hikimori. In both name and reality, I am the man who will be the home security guard for the old Torimaru mansion. But before that happy day arrives, two sad events have occurred.

The first is that my cousin, Haibara Rena, is getting married this weekend. The second is that with her marriage, the owner of the old Torimaru mansion, Haibara Aizen, will be joining us. My maternal grandfather suggested gathering all the direct descendants of the Haibara family at the old Torimaru mansion. I don't know if he's a local celebrity or an old family member, but the head of the family has an old, bad kinship mentality where anything he says is absolute, so the Haibara family has decided to stay at the old Torimaru mansion for a few days as a homestay guest.

There are seven people staying as homestay guests. The senile old man who suggested it. Haibara Aizen. My mother's younger sister, Haibara Shiho. Shiho's eldest daughter, Haibara Rena. Her second daughter, Haibara Aya. Her third daughter, Haibara Narumi. Aizen's adopted daughter, Haibara Shieri. Haibara Reina's fiancé, Miyano Kouji.
The culprit is among them. I swear by the name of my paternal grandfather.

[From [url=https://beelzebub.sakura.ne.jp/jitaku2/02_story.htm]Official website[/url]]
translation:
我叫灰原引守。无论名字还是现实，我都是将担任老鸟丸宅邸家庭保安的男人。不过在那幸福的一天到来前，已经发生了两件令人悲伤的事。

第一件，我的表妹灰原玲奈将在本周末结婚。第二件，随着她结婚，老鸟丸宅邸的主人灰原爱染将加入我们。我的外祖父提议，把灰原家所有直系后代聚集到老鸟丸宅邸。我们不知道他究竟是当地名人还是家族老成员，但家主有着古老而糟糕的亲族观念，他说的话就是绝对命令。因此，灰原家决定在老鸟丸宅邸寄宿几天。

寄宿者共有七人：提出建议的糊涂老人；灰原爱染；我母亲的妹妹灰原志保；志保的长女灰原玲奈；她的次女灰原彩；她的三女灰原成实；爱染的养女灰原诗绘里；以及灰原玲奈的未婚夫宫野浩司。

凶手就在他们之中。我以祖父之名发誓。

[来源：[url=https://beelzebub.sakura.ne.jp/jitaku2/02_story.htm]官方网站[/url]]
